title: Five Ways Target is Making Holiday Gifting Easier with AI and Technology
summary: Learn how Target is using AI and new technology to make holiday shopping easier, from smarter gift discovery and digital wish lists to deals and Drive Up.
body_markdown:
Gifting is at the heart of the holidays, and making that shopping experience easier is an especially important focus for busy families. Among these families, Target guest research found that more than 80% experience challenges during the discovery stage of shopping, and 58% of consumers say convenience is more important than price this holiday, underscoring the importance of making holiday shopping easier and less time consuming.


That's where technology can make a difference. From AI-powered gift discovery to connected wish lists, we're creating more intuitive shopping experiences on Target.com and the Target app so guests spend less time navigating holiday to-dos and more time enjoying the season.


> Finding great gifts should be part of the fun of the holidays, not another thing on your to-do list. That’s why we’re investing in technology that makes it easier to discover gifts on Target.com and in our app, so guests can spend less time searching and more time enjoying the season.
>
>
> Sarah Travis
>
>
> Chief Digital and Revenue Officer


Here's how we're helping guests tackle five familiar holiday shopping moments with greater ease and confidence this season.


#### 1. Find the perfect gift, with a little help from AI


Not sure what to get the person who already has everything? Need a hostess gift under $25? Guests can simply tell Ask Target, our AI-powered shopping assistant, what they have in mind and explore ideas from there, making it easier to go from “I have no idea” to “That’s perfect!”


Guests love how quickly Ask Target connects them with the right products. This seamless experience drives a **conversion rate more than double** the baseline for Target’s digital shoppers.


#### 2. All they want for the holidays, made easier


Keeping track of everyone's holiday wish lists can be a challenge, especially when family and friends are all getting in on the gifting fun. Our most expansive[digital Holiday Kids Catalog](https://www.target.com/catalog?type=holiday&pageId=1&brandId=Lego&ref=index) yet makes it simple for families to explore affordable favorites, save gift ideas, and easily share lists, helping everyone stay organized and connected.


The[interactive catalog](https://corporate.target.com/news-features/article/2026/10/target-holiday-kids-catalog) makes it easy to browse together, seamlessly add items to a wish list or cart, and share lists with family and other gift-givers. And for those who love flipping through the printed catalog, QR codes on each page connect directly to the digital experience.


The experience is already catching on, with Target guests quickly embracing the new catalog. In the first two weeks following this year's catalog launch, shoppers created **nearly 13 times more wish lists** than they did during the same timeframe last year.


And we're making the connection between paper and digital wish lists even easier. With our new Wish List Scanner, just scan a handwritten wish list to quickly turn it into a digital list in the Target app.


#### 3. Never miss a holiday deal


The holidays are full of great deals, but keeping track of them all can be a challenge. This season, guests can shop a new[Deal of the Day](https://www.target.com/c/target-deal-of-the-day/-/N-2sbk4) every day through Dec. 24, with a first-ever one-day preview of upcoming offers to help them plan ahead — making it easier to capture the best deals before they're gone.


See a deal you don't want to miss? Opt in to receive a push notification when that specific deal goes live, putting you in control of the deal alerts you receive. It's one less thing to keep track of, and another way guests can shop the deals that matter most to them.


#### 4. See something you love? Let a photo start the search


Sometimes the perfect gift starts with something you've spotted but can’t quite describe. Maybe it's a pair of sneakers your teen would love, a jacket that fits someone's style or a toy that caught your eye while browsing.


With AI-powered Photo Search, just tap the photo icon in Target's search bar, upload or take a picture and explore visually similar products available at Target. Instead of figuring out the right search terms in words, the picture becomes the easy starting point. And as the holidays approach, guests are increasingly using the tool for seasonal inspiration, with the **share of searches for holiday and seasonal items growing 75%** heading into November.


#### 5. Holiday pickup, picture perfect


We’re bringing a little extra holiday magic to Drive Up with a new in-app feature for snapping and sharing selfies with festive backgrounds while waiting for a Drive Up order. It adds a spark of surprise and delight to an everyday pickup, turning a few minutes of waiting into a memorable holiday moment that guests can capture and share.


From finding gift inspiration and organizing wish lists to adding a little festive fun to the holiday Drive Up experience, we’re helping guests simplify their holiday shopping — and delivering more delight along the way.
